claim.statement: Cursor's 3.6 changelog introduced Auto-review for Shell, MCP and Fetch: allowlisted calls run immediately, sandboxable calls run in the sandbox, and other actions go to a classifier that may allow, redirect or request approval.

source.title: Auto-review Run Mode
source.locator: 3.6 changelog, Auto-review execution path and settings

limitations: This is a 3.6 introduction milestone, not proof of identical policy, classifier or sandbox behavior in client 3.17.
The publisher description is not an independent enforcement or escape test.
unknowns: The complete allowlist matching rules, sandbox implementation and classifier policy for 3.17 are unknown.
The selected run mode and outcome for any tool call are unknown.

relationships.note: The 3.6 introduction milestone and later rolling publisher description discuss the same named feature under different time applicability; neither is projected into the other's scope.
